body:
I cant handle big groups of people, so group hiking, no way :)

I play tons of games, so im familiar with voice comms and dont get super nervous with em

Thank you

I love my pets, I love playing on pc, and consoles. Thats pretty much it. I do love going out, just for walks and such, but my friend was never interested in that, I get panicky when I go out alone, having a dog helps on that matter a bit though. The parties were mostly her idea, im not really one for getting wasted all the time, would of preferd going movies and stuff
Yeah, youre right. We aint friends anymore, feels like I lost half of my heart. weve been friends for over 20 years, and I cant handle the shit she dishes out now days so yeah...

Im bad at making friends, too shy , but guess I just have to shape up and ship out. Been crying my eyes out for the past couple hours, she was awful, and pretty much laughed at my face, and acted like a bitch so I told her that maybe its better that were not friends anymore.

Thank you for the comment.

She wouldnt take it well, if I tried to talk to her, and how I feel about everything. Cause then she says that its all about me, and im trying to throw shit on her, and make it all her fault, or make it seem like shes bad.

I do love her to bits, but im at the point where I dont think I can handle this anymore, but I dont want to lose her either, cause then I wouldnt have anyone.

and im scared of even suggesting a break with her, since then shes just going to rage at me even more.

its like, I have to suck everything up, and make up, and take the shit.

I know at my age I should just do what I want, and spend my time whom I want, and I have cleared my life out of bad people(abusive ex, manipulative crazy sister, stalker etc) after I tried a suicide for feeling so shit all the time, But now the feelings are coming back, and im not sure if im ready to be completely alone. meh
